entry.title: Reverbicon 224 1.0.0
entry.summary: # Reverbicon 224 1.0.0 The first release: the Lexicon 224's own v4.4 firmware running on an emulated 8080, DSP and converters, as a native MPC effect. ## What it is - **The real firmware, not a model of its sound.** The 224's control computer runs the v4.4 ROMs and programs the DSP row by row; audio goes through models of its gain-ranging converters and its input and output boards.
